event.text: You can start self-care at home now: wash skin and clothing, use cool compresses, and ask your pharmacist about an over-the-counter hydrocortisone cream and an anti-itch antihistamine. This pattern fits a poison ivy contact rash. Message us for clinician review if the rash becomes painful, warm and tender rather than itchy, spreads to your face or genitals, or isn't improving over the next week.
